LightningComponentBundle.description: Business-language change history for a Practice Location: practitioners, networks, taxonomies, NPI, info codes, provider features and associations added, removed or updated. Categories configured in PRM_PracticeLocationHistoryConfig__mdt.

property.name: defaultView
property.label: Default View
property.description: View shown when the component loads. Users can switch at runtime.

property.name: defaultDateRange
property.label: Default Date Range
property.description: Initial date filter in days (30, 90, 365) or all.

property.name: pageHeight
property.label: Component Height
property.description: CSS max-height for the scrolling area (e.g. 640px, 75vh). Empty = auto-grow.
